task: M0-09 real DSH research-extension handshake verification (G02/G04, R12)

decision.why: The frozen DSH client (@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 0.2.1-rc.2 on @modelcontextprotocol/client 2.2.0) hard-codes capabilities:{} and discards a top-level initialize extensions block, so no initialize-based negotiation is observable by the client. The handshake therefore rides the P1 discovery tool.

m0_13.detail: No upstream DSH client capability option or official adapter change is required: acp_capabilities is already in the eight-tool P1 allowlist and is callable by the unmodified client. No fork, patch or BOM entry is introduced.

extension.version_authority_note: application-api.v1.json::contract_version stays 1.1.0 (application contract); mcp_extensions["acp.research.v1"].version is a projection of the extension authority and is now 1.0.0 (was the B06 drift 1.1.0).

observed_dsh_behaviour.tools_list: tools/list is the whole model-visible surface: every advertised tool is registered and callable; there is no per-tool negotiation flag and no post-handshake gating.
observed_dsh_behaviour.absent_tool: A tool that is not in tools/list is not registered and cannot be called at all (JSON-RPC unknown_tool at the adapter), so an unimplemented research tool is uncallable by construction rather than by a negotiated=false check.
observed_dsh_behaviour.is_error_results: The official plugin converts an MCP isError result into a thrown tool failure (packages/mcp/mcp-client/src/tools.ts::createExecutor) whose message is the text content; structuredContent is not delivered to the model. The ACP adapter puts the whole machine envelope in that text, so the typed refusal is recoverable and the dsh-bundle adapter does exactly that (tested with a fake ctx.tools runtime).
observed_dsh_behaviour.tool_names: DSH registers MCP tools as mcp__<serverName>__<rawName> (publicToolName) and ctx.tools.execute takes that model-visible name; the adapter adds the mcp__acp__ prefix by default.

zero_side_effects.note: The loopback Controller stub counts every request; the handshake creates no task, prepare operation or run-root file.

not_verified: full DSH Agent end-to-end (model, skills, preset, ctx.tools registration, approval UX) - M3-01/M3-03
P2 research tools (10) are NOT delivered and stay implemented=false/negotiated=false
